title: Equilibrium density relations of a solid ball floating at interface of two immiscible liquids

extraction_metadata.source_misprint: Source text states '\rho_1, \rho_1 and \rho_3' instead of '\rho_1, \rho_2 and \rho_3'; faithfully preserved per Zero Pre-Verification rule.

question.statement: A jar is filled with two non-mixing liquids 1 and 2 having densities $\rho_{1}$ and $\rho_{2}$ respectively. A solid ball, made of a material of density $\rho_{3}$, is dropped in the jar. It comes to equilibrium in the position shown in the figure. Which of the following is true for $\rho_{1}$, $\rho_{1}\text{and }\rho_{3}$?

figure_refs.caption: Jar with two non-mixing liquid layers of densities $\rho_1$ and $\rho_2$ with a solid ball of density $\rho_3$ in equilibrium at the boundary.
figure_refs.alt_text: Cross-section of a jar containing two immiscible liquid layers: Liquid 1 of density rho_1 on top and Liquid 2 of density rho_2 on the bottom. A solid spherical ball of density rho_3 floats in static equilibrium straddling the interface between the two liquids.
